proposed_comments.title: Normalize persisted placements that are no longer selectable
proposed_comments.body:
### Normalize persisted placements that are no longer selectable

**Severity:** `medium`

Both recent-item ComboBoxes now hide the `BeforePinned` item, but persisted settings can still contain enum value `1` and the runtime continues to honor it. Upgrading users can therefore retain the ordering this change intends to disable while the settings control holds a hidden selection. Please normalize both `RecentCommandsOnQuickAccessShelf` and `RecentCommandsOnHome` from `BeforePinned` to `AfterPinned` during settings load, persist the migrated model, and add service-level regression coverage.

confidence.rationale: The current XAML hides index 1 while the model and runtime still accept and execute BeforePinned; a load-time normalization and persistence test directly resolves the upgrade path.

proposed_comments.title: Use the named Home surface consistently
proposed_comments.body:
### Use the named Home surface consistently

**Severity:** `low`

`Home` is the Command Palette surface name used by the surrounding settings text. Lowercasing it here reads like a generic location and is inconsistent with the UI terminology.

```suggestion
    <value>Pin a command to Home or adjust which pinned and recent items appear in Shelf settings. Empty shelves stay hidden.</value>
```

confidence.rationale: The added string directly names the same Home surface capitalized elsewhere, and the one-line replacement was compiled in the reviewed change set.
